infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location for safe-zone alerts and nearby housing resources.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location lets parents receive safe-zone alerts when a household member enters or leaves home, school, or work.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FamilyHub uses the microphone so you can talk to the AI housing assistant.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FamilyHub converts your speech to text for voice chat with the AI assistant.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Family Housing Hub to use your location for safe zones and nearby places.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow background location so safe-zone enter/leave alerts work when the app is closed.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow FamilyHub to use the microphone for voice chat with the AI assistant.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow FamilyHub to recognize your speech for voice chat with the AI assistant.
